page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.4xlarge belongs to the I/O-optimized Local SSD family, configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs spanning 8 physical cores on an Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The system provides 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core. A major hardware feature is its integrated 3839 GB of direct-attached local SSD storage. Network connectivity is rated at a 3 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The processor supports AVX and AVX-512 extensions under KVM virtualization, with no dedicated hardware accelerators or GPUs present.

Benchmark assessments demonstrate asymmetric compute characteristics. Single-core execution is modest, recording 929.0 in Geekbench single-core and 1104.58 in stress-ng single-core tests, placing single-threaded performance in the lower quadrant. However, multi-core scaling reaches the middle tier, scoring 5886.0 on Geekbench multi-core and 12957.15 on PassMark CPU. Memory bandwidth achieves 73.99 GB/sec for uncached read operations and 55.8 GB/sec for uncached writes on 256MB blocks, enabling Redis SET operations to sustain 11.77 million operations per second alongside 7.86 GB/sec in static web throughput.

The primary architectural tradeoff is the moderate per-thread instruction capability of the 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 platform relative to modern compute-focused instances. In return, the instance delivers high resource density via its massive bundled 3839 GB local SSD storage and 128 GB memory footprint without requiring separate network-attached disk allocations. This balance makes the ecs.i2.4xlarge suitable for high-throughput relational databases, distributed NoSQL stores, caching layers, and search indexing services where local I/O speed and memory capacity take priority over peak single-threaded processor speeds.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.4xlarge is a storage- and memory-focused virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. Configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores and 128.0 GB of system memory, the instance delivers a balanced 8 GB per vCPU ratio. A defining characteristic is its bundled 3839 GB local SSD storage volume, paired with a 3 Gbps network baseline. Synthetic benchmark measurements reveal modest single-thread capabilities, evidenced by lower Geekbench single-core results, but stable multi-threaded execution reaching average ratings across stress-ng and PassMark suites. Memory bandwidth remains solid at 73.99 GB/sec for uncached reads, enabling high transaction throughput such as 11.77 million Redis SET operations per second. With dense local storage capacity and substantial RAM, the ecs.i2.4xlarge is designed for distributed databases, caching systems, analytics, and transactional data workloads that require high local storage throughput.
